arxiv-2011-06008.title: Subleading BMS Charges and The Lorentz Group
arxiv-2011-06008.creator: Uri Kol
arxiv-2011-06008.description: Abstract The extended BMS group includes supertranslation, dual supertranslation and Lorentz transformations. The generators of these symmetries can be classified according to their parity into ”electric” and ”magnetic” types. Using a multipole expansion of gravitational sources in the Newman-Penrose formalism, we associate each one of these charges with a particular moment.

arxiv-2106-05101.creator: Jan Rozendaal
arxiv-2106-05101.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jan Rozendaal. We show that the Hardy spaces for Fourier integral operators form natural spaces of initial data when applying ℓ p \ell^{p} -decoupling inequalities to local smoothing for the wave equation. This yields new local smoothing estimates which, in a quantified manner, improve the bounds in the local smoothing conjecture on ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} for p ≥ 2 ​ ( n + 1 ) / ( n − 1 ) p\geq 2(n+1)/(n-1) , and complement them for 2 < p < 2 ​

arxiv-2111-10789.title: Development of a Data-Driven Method to Simulate the Detector Response of Anti-neutron at BESIII Journal: Nuclear instruments and methods in physics research A
arxiv-2111-10789.creator: Liang Liu, Xiaorong Zhou, Haiping Peng
arxiv-2111-10789.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Liang Liu, Xiaorong Zhou, Haiping Peng. In this paper, a data-driven method to precisely simulate the detector response of the anti-neutron depositing in the Electromagnetic Calorimeter (EMC) at BESIII is introduced. A large anti-neutron data sample can be selected using the decay J / ψ → p ​ n ¯ ​ π − J/\psi\to p\bar{n}\pi^{-} from the BESIII data sample of 10 billion J / ψ J/\psi events.

arxiv-2205-15430.title: Eigenvalue Bounds for Saddle-Point Systems with Singular Leading Blocks
arxiv-2205-15430.creator: Susanne Bradley, Chen Greif
arxiv-2205-15430.description: Abstract We derive bounds on the eigenvalues of saddle-point matrices with singular leading blocks. The technique of proof is based on augmentation. Our bounds depend on the principal angles between the ranges or kernels of the matrix blocks. Numerical experiments validate our analytical findings.

arxiv-2311-12815.title: Proposing an intelligent mesh smoothing method with graph neural networks
arxiv-2311-12815.creator: Zhichao Wang, Xinhai Chen, Junjun Yan, Jie Liu
arxiv-2311-12815.description: Abstract In CFD, mesh smoothing methods are commonly utilized to refine the mesh quality to achieve high-precision numerical simulations. Specifically, optimization-based smoothing is used for high-quality mesh smoothing, but it incurs significant computational overhead. Pioneer works improve its smoothing efficiency by adopting supervised learning to learn smoothing methods from high-quality meshes.

arxiv-2409-05961.title: Mapping Driven Oscillations in the Size of a Bubble to the Dynamics of a Newtonian Particle in a Potential
arxiv-2409-05961.creator: Uri Shimon, Ady Stern
arxiv-2409-05961.description: Abstract The non-linear dynamics of driven oscillations in the size of a spherical bubble are mapped to the dynamics of a Newtonian particle in a potential within the incompressible liquid regime. The compressible liquid regime, which is important during the bubble’s sonic collapse, is approached adiabatically.

arxiv-2503-05320.title: To See a World in a Spark of Neuron: Disentangling Multi-task Interference for Training-free Model Merging
arxiv-2503-05320.creator: Zitao Fang, Guodong Du, Shuyang Yu, Yifei Guo, Yiwei Zhang, Yiyao Cao, Jing Li, Ho-Kin Tang, Sim Kuan Goh
arxiv-2503-05320.description: Abstract Fine-tuning pre-trained models on targeted datasets enhances task-specific performance but often comes at the expense of generalization. Model merging techniques, which integrate multiple fine-tuned models into a single multi-task model through task arithmetic, offer a promising solution. However, task interference remains a fundamental challenge, leading to performance degradation and suboptimal merged models.

arxiv-2504-09684.title: An Adaptive Multivariate Functional Control Chart
arxiv-2504-09684.creator: Fabio Centofanti, Antonio Lepore, Biagio Palumbo
arxiv-2504-09684.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Fabio Centofanti, Antonio Lepore, Biagio Palumbo. New data acquisition technologies allow one to gather huge amounts of data that are best represented as functional data . In this setting, profile monitoring assesses the stability over time of both univariate and multivariate functional quality characteristics. The detection power of profile monitoring methods could heavily depend on parameter selection criteria, which usually do not take into account any information from the out-of-control (OC) state.

arxiv-2602-03966.title: Matchings: Source, Goal and Faithful Companion This article was prepared for the Centenary Issue of the Journal of the London Mathematical Society, it is submitted for publication in this journal.
arxiv-2602-03966.creator: András Sebő
arxiv-2602-03966.description: Abstract Matchings were among the earliest motivations for graph theory. They subsequently remained a central goal, inspiring the development of new tools that went well beyond problems directly concerning matchings. These tools proved widely applicable, accompanying the growth of graph theory over the past century. A legendary milestone in this trajectory is W. T.

pmc-10605975.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundA novel CT-linac (kilovolt fan-beam CT-linac) has been introduced into total marrow and lymphoid irradiation (TMLI) treatment. Its integrated kilovolt fan-beam CT (kV FBCT) can be used not only for image guidance (IGRT) but also to re-calculate the dose.PurposeThis study reported our clinical routine on performing TMIL treatment on the CT-linac, as well as dose distribution comparison between planned and re-calculated based on IGRT FBCT image sets.Methods11 sets of data from 5 male and 6 female patients who had underwent the TMLI

pmc-10649236.title: Assessment of the Tribological Performance of Electrospun Lignin Nanofibrous Web-Thickened Bio-Based Greases in a Nanotribometer
pmc-10649236.creator: María Borrego, Erik Kuhn, José E Martín-Alfonso, José M Franco, Csaba Balázsi, Md Abdul Maleque, Md Mustafizur Rahman
pmc-10649236.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The tribological performance of novel bio-based lubricating greases thickened with electrospun lignin nanostructures was investigated in a nanotribometer using a steel–steel ball-on-disc configuration. The impact of electrospun nanofibrous network morphology on friction and wear is explored in this work. Different lignin nanostructures were obtained with electrospinning using ethylcellulose or PVP as co-spinning polymers and subsequently used as thickeners in castor oil at concentrations of 10–30% wt. Friction and wear generally increased with thickener concentration.

pmc-10674913.title: Leak State Detection and Size Identification for Fluid Pipelines with a Novel Acoustic Emission Intensity Index and Random Forest
pmc-10674913.creator: Tuan-Khai Nguyen, Zahoor Ahmad, Jong-Myon Kim, Wai Lun Lo
pmc-10674913.description: In this paper, an approach to perform leak state detection and size identification for industrial fluid pipelines with an acoustic emission (AE) activity intensity index curve (AIIC), using b-value and a random forest (RF), is proposed. Initially, the b-value was calculated from pre-processed AE data, which was then utilized to construct AIICs.

pmc-10742663.title: Bacterial Pneumonia and Cryptogenic Pleuritis after Probable Monkeypox Virus Infection: A Case Report
pmc-10742663.creator: Hubert Dawid Ciepłucha, Mateusz Bożejko, Paweł Piesiak, Sylwia Serafińska, Bartosz Szetela
pmc-10742663.description: A large number of monkeypox (MPOX) cases have been reported in Europe and North America in 2022, and a new outbreak of this disease was declared. We describe a case of a patient with probable monkeypox during the height of this epidemic in Poland.

pmc-11330069.title: Virtual reality: a game-changer in the diagnosis and surgical planning of astrocytoma grade III: a case report
pmc-11330069.creator: Mohammed Alhamood, Amin Abbass, Rida Hasn
pmc-11330069.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundIn the dynamic realm of modern medicine, the advent of virtual reality technology heralds a transformative era, reshaping the contours of diagnosis and surgical planning with its immersive prowess. pmc-12405441.title: Nanofiber-interwoven gel membranes with tunable 3D-interconnected transport channels for efficient CO2 separation
pmc-12405441.creator: Hao-Nan Li, Ze-Yu Sun, Zhen-Jie Yu, Kexin Man, Chao Zhang, Zhi-Kang Xu
pmc-12405441.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Mixed matrix membranes (MMMs) capable of breaking the permeability-selectivity trade-off suffer from the inefficient and disconnected bulky transport channels as well as inferior interfacial compatibility between nanomaterials and polymers. Herein, we propose an original photothermal-triggered in-situ gelation approach to elaborate an original class of MMMs, termed nanofiber-interwoven gel membranes (NIGMs) that feature tunable 3D-interconnected ultrafast transport channels and highly-selective CO2-philic gel for boosting CO2 separation performance.

pmc-12747385.title: Vertical ground reaction force variables derived from Loadsol® insoles during overground walking are valid and reliable
pmc-12747385.creator: Dylan J. Mulligan, Clare E. Milner
pmc-12747385.description: Force sensing insoles for measuring vertical ground reaction force (VGRF) have several advantages over laboratory-based force plates. Data can easily be collected in real-world environments and long duration trials with multiple steps are feasible. However, the sampling rate of insoles is lower and only vertical force is recorded.

pmc-13240571.description: Background and AimBreast cancer remains a leading cause of cancer‐related mortality, and early detection through screening significantly improves survival outcomes. Given their accessibility, community pharmacists are well‐positioned to promote breast cancer screening. However, gaps in knowledge, attitudes, and perceptions (KAP) have limited their effectiveness in this role.

pmc-13532360.title: Rapidly reversible total facial paralysis after lipofilling around facial nerve truncus
pmc-13532360.creator: Ersin Yavuz, Emre Berk Bulut, Alp Ercan
pmc-13532360.description: Autologous fat grafting is widely used for secondary contour refinement following head and neck reconstruction and is generally considered safe. However, irradiated reconstructed tissues exhibit fibrosis and reduced compliance, potentially predisposing patients to uncommon complications. Transient facial nerve paralysis following fat grafting has not previously been reported in an irradiated anterolateral thigh (ALT) free flap.

pmc-13570296.title: Associations Between Teenage Motherhood, Perinatal Cortical Maturation, and Risk of Psychopathology in Children: The Mediating Role of Pregnancy Complications
pmc-13570296.creator: Andréa Paysserand, Raoul Belzeaux, Guillaume Auzias, Antoine Lefrere, Arnaud Cachia, Philippe Deruelle, Fabrizio Pizzagalli, Christine Deruelle
pmc-13570296.description: BackgroundChildren born to teenage mothers (<20 years) are at increased risk for psychopathology, partially due to atypical brain development. We explored whether this risk is mediated by perinatal complications more frequent in teenage pregnancies and by their impact on perinatal brain maturation as indexed by sulcal morphometry.

pmc-13588866.title: The Effect of EMG biofeedback in female patients with stress urinary incontinence: a randomized sham controlled blinded clinical study
pmc-13588866.creator: Basak Cigdem-Karacay, Esra Bayramoglu-Demirdogen, Naime Meric Konar, Selda Songur-Dagli, Figen Tuncay, Fatmanur-Aybala Kocak
pmc-13588866.description: AimThe effectiveness of EMG-BF in SUI has not yet been proven. This study aimed to the effectiveness of EMG-BF on pelvic floor muscle activity, pad test, severity of complaints, and quality of life in female patients with Stress Urinary Incontinence (SUI).
